Title: Retirement: Azure Maps Data Registry APIs V 2023-06-01 will be retired on September 30th, 2025.

Body.Content:
Azure Maps Data Registry APIs V 06-01-2023 will be retired on September 30th, 2025.
From now to September 30th, 2025, you can continue to use Azure Maps Data Registry API V 2023-06-01 without disruption. On September 30th, 2025—workloads running Azure Maps Data Registry API V 2023-06-01 will be deleted and associated application data will be lost.

Required action

To avoid service disruptions, please stop usage of Azure Maps Data Registry API V 2023-06-01 by September 30th, 2025.

Help and support

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.

  1. For Issue type, select Technical.
  2. For Subscription, select your subscription. 
  3. For Service, select My services, then select Maps.
  4. Select the Azure resource that you are creating a support request for.
  5. For Summary, type a description of your issue. 
  6. For Problem type, select “How-to development question”. 
  7. For Problem subtype, select “Select best available option”.
